headline: Truist Securities names Craig Mineard Co-Head of TMT Investment Banking
summary: Truist Securities today announced the appointment of Craig Mineard as Managing Director and Co-Head of Technology, Media, and Telecom (TMT) Investment Banking. Mineard joins Co-Head Thomas Wilson in leading the firm's industry coverage team, strengthening its position in the sector.

headline: Robert Half shares gain after BMO upgrades the stock
summary: Robert Half (NYSE:RHI) shares rose 1. 2% in pre-market trading after BMO Capital upgraded the staffing firm’s stock to Outperform from Market Perform and increased its price target to $47 from $45.

headline: SOFI Stock Down 40% YTD: Can Q2 Results Spark A Rebound?
summary: Truist raised the price target on SoFi to $18 from $17 and keeps a ‘Hold’ rating on the shares ahead of its Q2 results expected on July 29.
